overview: NotiForm is a decentralized web application built on the Internet Computer that centralizes government forms, scholarships, and job notifications. Citizens can browse opportunities, check eligibility, submit applications, and track their status — all from one place. Includes an admin panel, document vault, and a comprehensive project report page for academic and seminar use.
features: Notification dashboard for browsing government forms, scholarships, and job listings
Eligibility checker that matches user profile to opportunities
Document vault for storing important files
Admin panel for managing forms and reviewing applications
Internet Identity login with role-based access
Comprehensive project report page with 10 sections and table of contents
Print-friendly academic report for seminar use
Mock data pre-loaded for demo use
